data.name: GeneralInfoText
data.value: We take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This page informs you about how we collect and process data to ensure GDPR compliance.

data.name: LocalProcessingIntro
data.value: This project ("Filmdatenbank") is designed so that **all assets are loaded locally**. This means:

data.name: LocalProcessingItem1
data.value: No integration of Google Fonts via Google servers.

data.name: LocalProcessingItem3
data.value: No external trackers or analysis tools.

data.name: LocalProcessingFooter
data.value: As a result, no IP addresses are transmitted to third-party providers (e.g., in the USA) without being asked.

data.name: DataStorageText
data.value: The film data you enter (title, year, duration, price) is stored exclusively in the local project database (Entity Framework Core) and is not passed on to external services.
